list.comment: Register routers for `gym`, `user`, and `training` modules in FastAPI app.

task.summary: Default task

Add configuration management and database setup
- Introduced `pydantic-settings` for environment-based configuration in `config.py`. - Added placeholders for database configuration in `db.py`. - Updated dependencies in `pyproject.toml` to include `pydantic-settings`.

Add Docker support with Dockerfile and docker-compose
- Created a `Dockerfile` for containerizing the application. - Added `docker-compose.yml` for orchestrating services (FastAPI app, PostgreSQL, Redis).

Update dependencies and implement asynchronous database setup
- Added `asyncio` to dependencies for supporting asynchronous operations. - Implemented asynchronous database setup using `SQLAlchemy` with `AsyncSession` and `async_sessionmaker`.
Refactor database configuration to use dynamic `DATABASE_URL` generation from environment variables
Add `Exercise` model and `MuscleGroup` enum for exercise management

Add `User` model with fields for user management
- Introduced a `User` model under `app/modules/user/models.py`.

Add `Workout` model and `WorkoutStatus` enum for workout management
- Introduced a `Workout` model under `app/modules/workout/models.py`. - Created `WorkoutStatus` enum in `app/modules/workout/enums.py`.

Add `WorkoutExercise` and `WorkoutSet` models for detailed workout tracking
- Introduced `WorkoutExercise` model in `app/modules/workout_exercises/models.py` to associate exercises with workouts. - Added `WorkoutSet` model in `app/modules/workout_sets/models.py` to track sets, reps, and weights for exercises. - Updated `Workout` model imports to optimize and remove unused dependencies.

Refactor module structure: consolidate workout-related models under `training` and exercise-related models under `gym`
- Moved `Workout`, `WorkoutExercise`, and `WorkoutSet` models to `app/modules/training/models.py`. - Relocated `Exercise` model to `app/modules/gym/models.py`. - Updated imports and restructured enums accordingly. - Removed deprecated files and optimized relationships.

Update dependencies and Docker configuration
- Added `asyncpg` and `psycopg2` to `pyproject.toml` for PostgreSQL support. - Adjusted `CMD` in `Dockerfile` for better compatibility with the virtual environment.

Update `.env` and Docker configuration
- Introduced `.env` file for managing environment variables. - Updated `docker-compose.yml` to use `.env` for database configuration and added a volume for the Python virtual environment. - Replaced `psycopg2` with `psycopg2-binary` for simplified dependency management.

Update dependencies and improve database integration
- Upgraded `FastAPI` and `Alembic` dependencies to their latest versions. - Updated `created_at` field in the `User` model to use `server_default` with `func.now()` for accurate timestamp management. - Enhanced `.venv` setup in IDE configuration for improved project consistency.

Add Alembic integration and initial database migration
- Configured Alembic for managing database migrations, including `alembic.ini` and `env.py` setup. - Added an initial migration with `User`, `Exercise`, `Workout`, `WorkoutExercise`, and `WorkoutSet` tables.
Add `__init__.py` files for `gym`, `training`, and `user` modules to organize package structure

Add IDE data source configuration and base schema model
- Configured `.idea/dataSources.xml` for PostgreSQL `workout_db` connection in local development. - Introduced `CustomModel` in `schemas.py` with `ConfigDict` for `pydantic` configuration.

Add Pydantic schemas for `User` module
- Introduced `UserBase`, `UserCreate`, `UserUpdate`, and `UserResponse` schemas in `schemas.py` for user data validation and serialization.

Add Pydantic schemas for `Training` module
- Introduced schemas for `Workout`, `WorkoutExercise`, and `WorkoutSet` in `schemas.py` for validation and serialization. - Updated dependencies (`email-validator`, `ruff`) in `pyproject.toml` and IDE configurations.

Add Pydantic schemas for `Gym` module
- Introduced schemas for `Exercise`, including `ExerciseBase`, `ExerciseCreate`, `ExerciseUpdate`, and `ExerciseResponse` in `schemas.py` for validation and serialization. - Updated `Exercise` model to refine relationships and remove unused comments.

Add CRUD service functions for `Gym` module
- Implemented `create_exercise`, `get_all_exercises`, `get_exercise_by_id`, `update_exercise`, and `del_exercise` functions in `service.py` for managing `Exercise`. - Updated IDE workspace configuration.

Add custom exceptions for `Training` module
- Introduced custom exceptions `WorkoutNotFoundError`, `WorkoutExerciseNotFoundError`, `WorkoutSetNotFoundError`, and `WorkoutAlreadyCompleted` in `exceptions.py` to improve error handling.

Add custom exceptions for `Training` module
- Introduced custom exceptions `WorkoutNotFoundError`, `WorkoutExerciseNotFoundError`, `WorkoutSetNotFoundError`, and `WorkoutAlreadyCompleted` in `exceptions.py` to improve error handling.

Add custom exceptions for `Core` module
- Introduced `AppError`, `NotFoundError`, and `BadRequestError` in `exceptions.py` to standardize error handling across the application.

Add CRUD service functions for `Training` module
- Implemented functions to manage `Workout`, including `create_workout`, `get_workout_by_id`, `get_user_workouts`, `update_workout_info`, and `del_workout` in `service.py`. - Updated IDE workspace configuration.

Add CRUD service functions for `WorkoutSet` and `WorkoutExercise`
- Implemented `create_workout_set`, `update_workout_set`, `delete_workout_set`, and `get_workout_set_by_id` functions for managing workout sets. - Added `create_workout_exercise`, `update_workout_exercise`, and `get_workout_exercise_by_id` for handling workout exercises. - Corrected typo in `get_user_workouts` query (`ordery_by` → `order_by`).

Add `delete_workout_exercise` function and enhance `update_workout_exercise` logic
- Implemented `delete_workout_exercise` for removing workout exercises. - Improved `update_workout_exercise` to handle unset fields dynamically and raise `WorkoutExerciseNotFoundError` when necessary.

Fix `workout_exercise_id` assignment in `create_workout_set` and enhance `WorkoutExercise` service methods
- Corrected argument name in `create_workout_set` (from `workout_exercise` to `workout_exercise_id`). - Enhanced exception handling in `get_workout_exercise_by_id` and `update_workout_exercise` to include `workout_exercise_id` in error messages. - Adjusted `create_workout_exercise` implementation to set proper fields and ensure commit/return consistency.

Add `UnauthorizedError` exception for user authentication
- Introduced `UnauthorizedError` in `exceptions.py` to standardize credential validation errors.
Add `Token` and `TokenData` schemas to support authentication responses

Add core authentication utilities to `security.py`
- Implement password hashing and validation functions. - Add `create_access_token` for JWT generation. - Introduce `get_current_user` to decode tokens and authenticate users.

Add `authenticate_user` function to user service for credential validation
- Implemented `authenticate_user` to verify user credentials using the database and password hashing logic. - Returns the user object on success or `False` on failure.

Add `create_user` function to user service for registration and enhance `authenticate_user` logic
- Implemented `create_user` to handle user registration, including validation, password hashing, and database insertion. - Updated `authenticate_user` to return `None` instead of `False` for invalid credentials.

Add user authentication routes for registration and login
- Introduced `/register` route to handle user registration. - Added `/login` route for user authentication and token generation using JWT.
Remove unused `OAuth2PasswordBearer` import in `user/route.py`
Adjust `/login` route to return `Token` schema instead of `UserResponse` for consistency with authentication design
Restructure module routes by renaming `user/route.py` to `user/router.py` and introducing `gym/router.py`
Add CRUD routes for managing exercises in `gym/router.py`
Raise `ExerciseNotFoundError` in `get_exercise_by_id`, `update_exercise`, and `del_exercise` when the exercise is not found
Add CRUD routes for managing workouts in `training/router.py`

Update workout service functions to enhance filtering, validation, and error handling
- Added `last_workout_id` and `limit` parameters to `get_user_workouts` for pagination. - Updated `update_workout_info` and `del_workout` to fetch workouts by ID and raise `WorkoutNotFoundError` when not found.
Enhance workout set service functions with user-specific validation and refined error handling
Enhance workout set service functions by adding user-specific validation for fetching and deleting workout sets
Add CRUD routes for managing workout sets in `training/router.py`
Remove redundant error handling in workout set service functions
Enhance workout exercise service with user-specific validation, refined error handling, and support for exercise existence checks
Add user-specific validation to workout exercise service functions and refine error handling
Add CRUD routes for managing workout exercises in `training/router.py`
Update workout, workout-set, and workout-exercise routes to use consistent pluralized endpoints
Update workout-related routes to use nested and pluralized endpoints for consistency
